Name: Purple Foliage - A swampy and magical Simple Foliage Recolor
Author: voidcultist666
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pdCO9xY.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[center]This mod adds a highly configurable recolored version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ that was made to match the other more witchy recolors and maps out there. [s]It's not exclusively purple[/s]
Including recolors of the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35354] Fir and Birch SVE trees[/url] (as well as fruit trees) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44029]East Scarp Fruit Trees[/url]﻿ in the style of Simple Foliage![/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4yZx3AD.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Currently a WIP. 
List of tree recolors that will be added in the future:
[list]
[*]TerrainFeatures trees (aka the wild trees that can be felled with an axe)
[*]Fruit Trees (Vanilla)
[*]Island Tilesheet trees
[*]Green Rain trees
[/list]
I am open for recommendations but will not promise that I will actually work on them.In the meantime, until the other foliage recolors are done, I totally recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25720]Bog's Witchy Foliage[/url] for the trees that haven't been added yet. My mod has been written in a way so you can mix and match both mods if you want to by enabling and disabling the trees you want from the Config Settings.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/xLlTiP3.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Mods that go well with Purple Foliage:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40045]OURple Grass for Grass Variety[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27656]Luny's Purple Swamp Fields (More Grass)[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (this mod has a lot of settings that are easier to toggle with this)
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/gFeyJ9c.png[/img]﻿[/center][list]
[*]All of the ones mentioned above
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23742]Nightshade[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37450]Luny's Summer Witch Attire[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631][/url][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631]Aimon's Small Swamp Farm[/url]

[/list]
